hero.lead: We believe traditional agencies spend energy in the wrong place: filling a window. Here, the work is understanding the buyer, and going to find exactly what they want.

manifesto.text_part1: We believe buyers deserve more than
manifesto.text_part2: on a weekend. They deserve someone to take the briefing and go after it.
manifesto.text_part3: And sellers deserve to know if anyone wants their property

cities.title: Today in Rio. Soon, more.
cities.c1_body: HQ in Cinelândia. Serving the capital, metropolitan region, Região dos Lagos, Serra and Costa Verde.
cities.c2_body: Launch planned after validating the Rio pilot. Capital + interior on the roadmap.
cities.c3_body: Launch planned after validating the Rio pilot. Whole metropolitan area on the roadmap.

principles.title: What we believe.
principles.p1_b: We'll tell you when a property is overpriced. When the neighborhood doesn't fit you. When your target price is unrealistic.
principles.p2_b: You don't bend to our schedule. We work on your deadline.
principles.p3_b: We work with or without exclusivity. We trust our service to convince you to stay.
